Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Jesper Bøje wrote:
>
> Hey there
> We are a few players here, there just want some quick answers on a few
questions, so if you got the time LSJ:
>
> 1. I have read some time ago that you cant give Beast equipment with
Heiddelburg Castle. Is this true?!?

Yes. Beast cannot possess Equipment through any means:

Beast, Leatherface of Detroit [SAB] - vampire (NosA)

* Replace card text with "Beast cannot perform action-card actions or
recruit allies. He cannot have or use equipment or retainers. As a (D)
action, Beast can enter combat with any Ready minion controlled by
another Methuselah. +1 hand damage." [RTR 980623]

> 2. Can you, again with Heiddelburg Castle, transfer clan specifik retainers to
aother vampire that dosent belong to that klan. Eg. transfer a zombie to Wynn.

Yes.

> 3. If you cant. Then can you take a clan specifik location with "Dissputed
Territory" if you dosent have the clan. Eg. Can you take an "Uptown
Huntingground" if you dosent got any Ventrues.
> What about "Ankarah Citadel"

Yes and Yes.

> 4a. Are Caitiffs a clan, in Vampire the Masqurad they aret, I mean that what

makes then Caitiffs, that they are clanless. But in V:TES are they a clan
there, can they be choosed when playing eg. "Consageinous Boon"

They are not a clan. They cannot be chosen for the Boon.

> 4b Can Caitiffs be princes????

Yes, as they are Camarilla vampires.

> 5. Can you get a clan specifik card, if you only have the vampires in Torpor.

No. Rules specify that you must control a "ready" member of that clan.

> 6. A vampire that cant hunt, if he/she dosent he/she goes to torpor right?

No. A vampire who can't hunt is otherwise unaffected.
Pulled Fangs adds a "go to torpor" clause by card text, but that is not
the genral rule.

> NOw what happens if the hunting vampire gets blocked, use a change of target,

untaps, if your playing with the No Repeating Actions he cant hunt again, if
he donsent he goes to torpor. But dosent that seem a bit unfair, afterall he
tried to hunt.

Moot. He remains ready, empty, and untapped. He cannot perform any other
action (since ready empty vampires cannot do anything except hunt), however.
